intro: Community Analytics counts attendance and interactions without storing chat text, names, avatars, money, or raw payloads. Viewer Foundation supplies every identity.

sections.title: 1. Start safely
sections.description: Viewer Foundation must be installed and enabled first.

sections.title: 2. Privacy and exclusions
sections.description: Use stable IDs only. Bots and system actors are always skipped.

sections.title: 3. Optional engagement score
sections.description: Create a capped monthly participation score from observed sessions, messages, and commands only.
sections.notice: Money, subscriptions, gifts, Bits, Jewels, donations, and provider support never affect this score. Exact rank stays private until the eligible cohort reaches your minimum.

sections.title: 4. Local retention limits
sections.description: Oldest viewer and session records are removed when these caps are reached.
sections.notice: Stored data is limited to Viewer Foundation IDs, timestamps, session attendance, counters, capped monthly score inputs, and replay fingerprints. Counts are local automation observations, not official platform analytics or revenue reports.
